name: Emergence Zone
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
blocked_sentences: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.

needs.what: an effect op that writes a turn-scoped, per-player timing permission -- "you may cast spells this turn as though they had flash" -- that `legality._timing_ok` consults alongside the printed keyword, ideally with an optional selector so the narrower printings ("cast creature spells", "cast Spirit spells", "cast this spell as though it had flash") and the permanent/static form ("During each opponent's end step, you may cast spells as though they had flash") land on the same permission
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Timing is decided entirely by `legality._timing_ok` (src/automtg/engine/legality.py:680), which returns True only for `card.is_instant` or `Keyword.FLASH.value in card.keywords` -- printed characteristics read off the CardDef -- and otherwise falls back to the sorcery-speed window from `_can_act_at_sorcery_speed`. Nothing in the game state can widen it. `grant_keyword` with `flash` is the tempting substitute and is wrong twice: `_timing_ok` never reads an object's granted keywords, and even if it did, the grant would reach only the cards sitting in hand when the ability resolved, while the printed line covers every spell cast for the rest of the turn -- cards drawn later, cards cast from other zones, cards that were not yet visible. `grant_playable` (ops_cards.py:132) is a *zone* permission, not a timing one: it sets `playable_by`/`playable_turn` so a card may be cast from somewhere other than hand, at its printed timing, and it moves no timing restriction at all. `set_turn_flag` writes a flag only `has_turn_flag` conditions read; no legality path consults the turn ledger for casting speed. `become_prepared` and `play_exiled` are both about a specific stashed card, not a standing permission over the whole turn. The rest of the line -- the `{1}` + `tap` + `sacrifice` cost and the mana ability -- is fully expressible; only the effect is missing, so no partial answer was written.
